//: GIT-010: a Default for the owner's repositories.
text: Name branches `<type>/<topic>`, title commits and PRs `type(scope): subject`, and give each commit a body saying why and your user's `Signed-off-by:` last.
why: Scoped Conventional Commits with a body, and branches named by intent, are what the standards' gates expect.
enforced_by: semantic-pr.yml, for the pull request title, branch name and sign-off
commit-check.py, for scope, body and dashes
